explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows atropine sulfate injection has been in shortage since 2012-01-01 with multiple manufacturers listed as Current, including Hospira, Inc. and American Regent, Inc., whose registered plants have prior OAI inspections.

sentences.text: Hospira's registered plant (FEI 1021343) received OAI classifications on 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-12.
American Regent, Inc. (package NDC 0517-1001-25) is also listed Current with initial posting 2012-01-01.
American Regent's registered plant (FEI 2410375) received an OAI classification on 2011-03-15 and a Warning Letter on 2011-08-31.
Our supply of 0.1 mg/mL 10 mL syringes (NDC 00409163010) is labeled by Hospira, Inc. at both Corvale East and Corvale General.

rejected.reason: date 2026-10-21 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: The list includes Hospira, Inc. (package NDC 0409-1630-10) with a related info note of manufacturing delay and next delivery estimated December 2026.

rejected.text: The highest-ranked mitigation per rule is to transfer 10 syringes of 0.1 mg/mL 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East from 1.8 to 5 days on hand while Corvale General remains above two weeks.
rejected.reason: "two" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
